trustRules: Target specialization names, counts, statuses, medallions, source labels, windows and notes are placeholders and never runtime facts.
The route renders only records returned by builds.intel; target card count defines visible geometry, not API list length.
Top-level dataStatus=verified proves the response-level source state only and does not upgrade item-level ranking or numeric claims.
sampleCount, maxKeyLevel and bestScore are unusable while the source is blocked or numericValuesUsable is not explicitly true; zero values are never displayed as measured facts.
The route must not render rank, tier, DPS, score, key level, sample count, BiS or recommendation claims from the current payload.
Backend iconUrl may be displayed only through the trusted runtime media allowlist and remains a fact-bearing specialization reference, never generated art.
SourceName and sourceUrl are displayed as a reference, not an official endorsement; source copy is enabled only when the URL is present.
All five real records remain reachable through the target-owned card scroll surface while three stable card slots remain visible at the baseline viewport.
Role filters and source/name ordering are deterministic client views over the returned records and never imply popularity or performance ranking.

stateContract.loading: mount all seven regions with summary, controls, three card skeletons and the disclaimer at final first-level geometry
stateContract.ready: render all returned records in the internal card scroll surface with three visible target slots
stateContract.partial: preserve every region and mark missing source, window, icon and note independently
stateContract.stale: preserve cached records and label the route/cards as local fallback without freshness claims
stateContract.blocked: preserve all regions, disable source/simulator actions that cannot be supported and expose the backend reason in card copy
stateContract.error: preserve all regions with a deterministic retry action in the first card slot
stateContract.empty: preserve all regions and three truthful empty card slots without inventing records
